questions.q_en:
Ten persons - P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order) at an equidistant. P is opposite to Y. Four persons are between U and X. T sits second to the right of Y. X is neighbour of V and T. R and W are neighbours. Q sits second to the right of S.

Which of the following seating arrangement cannot be possible (in the anticlockwise direction)?

I. P, R, W, S, U, Q, V, X, T

II. P, W, R, U, S, Y, Q, T, X, V

III. X, T, Q, S, Y, V, R, P, W
questions.solution_en:
Ten persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order) at an equidistant.

P is opposite to Y.

T sits second to the right of Y.

X is neighbour of V and T. Four persons are between U and X.

R and W are neighbours. Q sits second to the right of S.

So, both I and III cannot be possible.

questions.q_en: If in a row, 10 persons stand between person A and person B. Person C stands 15th to the right of person B, then how many minimum number of persons can stand in a row?
questions.solution_en:
If in a row, 10 persons stand between person A and person B.

Case 1A10 personsB
Case 2B10 personsA

Person C stands 15th to the right of person B.

Case 1A10 personsB14 personsC
Case 2B10 personsA3 personsC

Therefore, from the both cases,

Case 1: Minimum number of persons = 27

Case 2: Minimum number of persons = 16

Minimum number of persons standing in a row is 16 persons.

questions.q_en:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means 'P is the mother of Q',

P - Q means 'P is the brother of Q',

P x Q means 'P is the wife of Q' and

P ÷ Q means 'P is the father of Q'.

Based on the above, how is U related to Z if 'U - V + W ÷ Y x Z'?
questions.solution_en:
U - V: U is the brother of V

V + W: V is the mother of W

W ÷ Y: W is the father of Y

Y x Z: Y is the wife of Z

So, U is the Wife's Father's Mother's brother of Z.

questions.q_en: Today is Siara's birthday which falls on Saturday, Geetika's birthday falls after 60 days after Siara's birthday and 41 days before Fatima's birthday. On which day Fatima's birthday falls?
questions.solution_en:
Siara's birthday falls on Saturday

To find the day after 60 days

Nearest multiple of 7 = 56

So, after 56 there will be Saturday

60 - 56 = 4

Saturday + 4 = Wednesday

Geetika birthday will be on Wednesday

Geetika's birthday falls 41 days before Fatima's birthday

So, after 35 days there will be Wednesday

41 - 35 = 6

Wednesday + 6 = Tuesday

Hence, Fatima's birthday will fall on Tuesday.
